auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Vida API token passed as the token query parameter. Manage tokens under Settings > Developers: https://vida.io/docs/api-reference/authentication.

actions.name: get_account
actions.description: Get details for the Vida account authenticated by the current API token.

targetAccountId.description: A child account identifier used by partner or reseller tokens.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for getting Vida account details.

username.description: The username associated with the Vida account.

details.description: Additional account details returned by Vida.

actions.name: get_daily_counts
actions.description: Get current daily Vida call, text, and task usage counts.

targetAccountId.description: A child account identifier used by partner or reseller tokens.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for getting Vida daily usage counts.

success.description: Whether Vida reports that the request succeeded.

calls.description: The number of calls counted today.

texts.description: The number of text messages counted today.

tasks.description: The number of tasks counted today.

date.description: The calendar date for these usage counters.

outputSchema.description: The Vida daily usage count response.

actions.name: get_task
actions.description: Get one Vida task by its identifier.

targetAccountId.description: A child account identifier used by partner or reseller tokens.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for getting one Vida task.

success.description: Whether Vida reports that the request succeeded.

type.description: The task type, such as call, text, email, or ping.

target.description: The destination targeted by the task.

createdAt.description: The Unix timestamp when the task was created.

actions.name: get_task_statistics
actions.description: Get Vida task counts grouped by state.

targetAccountId.description: A child account identifier used by partner or reseller tokens.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for getting Vida task statistics.

success.description: Whether Vida reports that the request succeeded.

total.description: The total number of tasks counted.

additionalProperties.description: The number of tasks in this state.

byState.description: Task counts keyed by Vida task state.

actions.name: list_tasks
actions.description: List Vida tasks with optional pagination, time, sorting, and correlation filters.

limit.description: The maximum number of tasks to return.

offset.description: The zero-based number of tasks to skip.

since.description: Only return tasks updated at or after this Unix timestamp.

until.description: Only return tasks updated at or before this Unix timestamp.

sort.description: The task field used for sorting.

externalTaskId.description: An exact caller-defined task correlation identifier.

targetAccountId.description: A child account identifier used by partner or reseller tokens.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Vida tasks.

success.description: Whether Vida reports that the request succeeded.

total.description: The total number of matching tasks.

type.description: The task type, such as call, text, email, or ping.

target.description: The destination targeted by the task.

createdAt.description: The Unix timestamp when the task was created.

outputSchema.description: The paginated Vida task list response.
